# Overview

The fixture corpus links to [the guide](guide/), to [the CLI page](reference/cli.md),
and to [the requirements section](guide/install#requirements).

Freeze windows run from Friday 17:00 to Monday 09:00, and the read CLI maps 1:1
to the SDK.
